mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_operate_time (store_id, opened_at, date) SELECT #{storeId}, NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM store_operate_time WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND DATE(date) = CURRENT_DATE() )
mapper.update: UPDATE store_operate_time SET closed_at = NOW() WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND DATE(date) = CURRENT_DATE()
mapper.select: SELECT opened_at FROM store_operate_time WHERE store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY opened_at DESC LIMIT 1
